summary.text: Adam Turk is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 117 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Adam Turk graduated from Baldwin High School, earned an associate degree in criminal justice/law enforcement administration from the Community College of the Air Force, and received a bachelor's degree in criminal justice administration from Missouri Southern State University in 2010.
He has served in the Kansas Air National Guard, reaching the rank of master sergeant, and his career experience includes owning two 9Round fitness clubs and Dominion Consulting, LLC.
Turk took office representing Kansas House District 117 on January 9, 2023, succeeding Tatum Lee.

In the 2025–2026 session he was vice chair of the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development Committee and was assigned to the Appropriations Committee, the General Government Budget Committee and the J. Russell (Russ) Jennings Corrections and Juvenile Justice Oversight Committee.
